routing.title: Account distribution
routing.description: How requests spread across these accounts. An account at a usage limit is skipped while another still has room.
routing.label: Account distribution for {provider}
routing.group: {group, select, quota {Uses plan limits} simple {Simple} other {{group}}}
routing.method: {strategy, select, inherit {Per model alias} smart {Smart} quota_balanced {Most headroom} quota_expiring {Soonest reset} round_robin {Round robin} priority {Priority} least_inflight {Least busy} other {{strategy}}}
routing.hint: {strategy, select, inherit {Each model alias uses its own load-balance mode from Models.} smart {Spends quota that resets soon and steers clear of accounts close to a limit.} quota_balanced {Picks the account with the most room left on its tightest limit.} quota_expiring {Picks the account whose tightest limit resets first.} round_robin {Takes turns so all accounts wear evenly.} priority {Fills the account with the highest endpoint weight first, then moves on.} least_inflight {Sends each request to the account with the fewest running requests.} other {}}
routing.priorityNote: Weights are set per endpoint on the model groups in <link>Models</link>.
routing.single: Only one account, so it serves every request. With more accounts, this method applies: {method}.

pausedHint: This account is paused and receives no requests. Its limits stay visible.

antigravity.title: Google OAuth client
antigravity.description: Antigravity sign-in needs the secret of Google's public OAuth client. It is stored sealed and never shown again.
antigravity.label: OAuth client secret
antigravity.hint: Paste the client secret of the Antigravity desktop OAuth client. Without it, signing in is disabled.
